Overview

We are a growing team and we are excited to welcome new people to our organization this
year. Our mission is to make operations simpler for everyone.

About Us

Lakeview Provisions is a food distribution business operating across Eastern Ontario. We
have been serving independent grocers since 2004.

The Opportunity

You will join a small team and help with a variety of tasks across the business, including
scheduling, vendor communication, and general administrative support. This is a broad role
and the responsibilities will change over time depending on business needs.

What You Bring

- Strong organizational habits
- Comfort with spreadsheets
- Willingness to learn

Location: Kingston, ON
